# Test 06: Record cross-product coverage
# Pair has two Shape components. All four combinations covered.
# Expected: exhaustive

TYPES
sealed Shape Circle Square
record Circle double:radius parent:Shape
record Square double:side parent:Shape
record Pair Shape:first Shape:second

SWITCHES
switch s1 Pair
record Pair(type:Circle,type:Circle)
record Pair(type:Circle,type:Square)
record Pair(type:Square,type:Circle)
record Pair(type:Square,type:Square)
end
